items.title: The Third Path of Exile 1 ExileCon Qualifier Is Going Live!
items.excerpt: Will you be the next to join allexpleblord and imexile at ExileCon 2026? Join the third Path of Exile 1 Qualifier for your chance to earn a spot in the finale this November! If you’re not participating, tune in to the stream, going live in 15 minutes at https://www.twitch.tv/pathofexile! Once the race kicks off, the new Twitch Drop will be available for 24 hours, until 2 PM PDT on September 18. Watch the official broadcast or any channel streaming Path of Exile 1 for 30 minutes during the race, or catch up with your favourite content creator afterwards to receive the Darkshard Helmet Attachmen...

items.title: The Third Path of Exile 1 ExileCon Qualifier Begins Tomorrow - Earn Twitch Drops
items.excerpt: Catch the third ExileCon Path of Exile 1 Qualifier tomorrow at 2 PM PDT on September 17, at https://www.twitch.tv/pathofexile. Earn the Darkshard Helmet Attachment by watching the official broadcast or any Path of Exile 1 stream for 30 minutes. Twitch Drops will be available for 24 hours once the race begins and will end at 2 PM PDT on September 18. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5193306/c75f64f971d4c51413423f49be1dc319f2bc36b7.jpg If you’re participating in the Qualifier, don’t forget to link your Twitch account and stream throughout the entire event. Check out the full ruleset here. Good luck!

items.title: Fan Art Competition Winners
items.excerpt: Our Fan Art Competition concluded last week, with more than 150 Exiles submitting artwork inspired by the latest Path of Exile and Path of Exile 2 content expansions. With the help of our art team, we’ve selected the winners and are now ready to announce them! Because of the enormous number of amazing submissions, it was really hard to select just three overall winners. So, we decided to award the top five winners in both games, as well as introduce a separate category for the top physical art submissions. Click here to check out the winners! items.title: Path of Exile 1 Build Showcase: Luminary Facebreaker
items.excerpt: Turn your fists into the heaviest matter in Wraeclast with today's Build Showcase episode. This Luminary Facebreaker build by Alohaa features the new Scion Ascendancy and relies on a specific Mercenary for its core interaction. Check it out! Thanks to Alohaa for putting this build together. For more information, refer to their video guide here. See you next time!

If you'd like to submit an entry, you can do so by posting in this thread. Submissions close on Wednesday, 2nd September at 10PM PDT! items.title: Path of Exile 2's first event league goes 'oops, all bosses' and reworks its worst mode so sane people can finally enjoy it
items.excerpt: fter the tremendous Return of the Ancients update to Path of Exile 2, it wouldn't take much to convince me to play more of it. The action RPG is the best it's ever been and finally feels ready to come out later this year.
